description: The documented temperature model predicts household drinking-water temperatures. A full-scale domestic installation was run with one year of stochastic demands at 10-second steps, and point-of-use temperatures supported validation. This resource is provided by Ljiljana Zlatanovic; Andreas Moerman; Jan Peter van der Hoek and coauthors. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists JPG formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The deposit is supplementary material for one study; the record describes a documented method, not a verified executable model. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
